economicQuestion: Can causally observed liquidity-pressure, cross-asset dispersion and volatility-tail states predict future returns and add net economic contribution in one capital-limited EUR200 multi-asset portfolio after a separately observed next-bar entry and joint open-position risk?
distinction: New explanatory event-state Bayesian conditional regression rather than IPF1's multi-resolution 6-feature SGD; no IPF1 forecast, model, weights, parameters, backtest or ablation re-execution.
sourceReuse: Only encrypted original Pepperstone readback and causal source cost-context functions. Already exposed yearly calendar: no independent holdout.
universe: All authentic original Pepperstone symbols; new economically justified symbols may be collected in a different, separately registered research protocol; never infer missing source.
decisionClock: Every complete H4 UTC closing clock among [0,4,8,12,16,20] hours for all authentic instruments, with no forward-fill of absent M5 bars.
executionClock: Exactly one completed and independently observed next M5 bar end at DecisionClock+300000ms, AFTER signal. Missing next bar means no fill/no trade; not a fill at the known signal bar.
exitClock: Exactly ObservedEntryClock+HoldingMinutes*60000; no estimated fill if missing. Later positively observed exit is an unresolved/delayed scenario with additional funding or withheld accounting, never a guaranteed scheduled fill.
targetForLearning: Forward completed next-M5-entry-to-prespecified-exit log return, matured only when both exact entry and exit source marks are known and their future clock has passed.

families.hypothesis: When prior 4h trading ranges compress relative to five days but activity accelerates and price closes at a range extreme, latent inventory repricing may persist or reverse with time; regression learns the historical sign with shrinkage.
Excess 24h normalized price displacement vs a broad causal developed-index factor can predict later convergence/continuation without ex-post estimating index betas.
Activity-heavy H4 asymmetric wicks combined with true-range expansion represent transient trade-pressure proxy; posterior learns forward direction. It is not actual DOM or dealer inventory.

model.ensemble: equal weights three family slopes, zero baseline retained; no retrospective winner
model.intervals: posterior variability descriptive, not certified probability

phase.splits: 26 weeks development/13 selection/13 exposed audit, ALL globally exposed

economics.jointScenarios: Eight predecision weekly historical aligned states, including each existing open position's incremental future return, intrahorizon downside, favorable equity and remaining margin. No independent or zero-existing baseline assumption.
economics.modeledAdmission: forecast net after adverse 2-side spread/slippage and current-term commission/funding; reject when expected net non-positive; no broker fill certificate
economics.quoteAndSizing: Actual original development BID/ASK context, current broker contract minimum volume and margin; no historic synthetic real fill. One broker-minimum step per scenario, max 3 only if funded by same capital; no symbol-level independent wallets.
economics.markPolicy: Observation of every full H1 time in actual available market while positions open, with no missing equitization; unknown exposure prevents new entries but may be reobserved later. Historical lifetime DD not certified.
economics.eligibilityWeeks: All 13 complete selection weeks and 13 exposed audit weeks recorded; no outcome-based exclusion. Count modeled complete round trips at system level. HARD21 proof remains false.
economics.contrasts: Native C# selector applied independently to fixed policy alternatives from same EUR200 starting capital and same source. Difference in EUR is path-dependent marginal policy contrast, not summable alpha.
economics.independentNet: Impossible on globally exposed conditional book without authenticated historic bid/ask actual fills and full funding + independent external untouched evaluation; never claim.
economics.fullStressSensitivity: Same exact causal candidate predictions and 200 EUR book but stress rather than adverse total friction applied to both C# admission and booked costs; never chosen after results

benchmark.pairedInformation: Full prequential completed outcomes per family/phase, with unknown target and historical scenario gaps reported, do not select winner.

researchOutput: Complete family, phase, horizon, missingness, MSE/Brier and 5-policy EUR200 modeled book; negative/zero result is material; no automatic promotion based on exposed ablation.
